tools.name: daily_wisdom
tools.description: Today’s quote from Wisdom Web by Six Eight: one public-domain line, checked word for word against its Project Gutenberg source, with author, book and source link. Everyone gets the same line on the same day (UTC).

tools.name: search_quotes
tools.description: Searches Wisdom Web’s library of public-domain quotes, each checked against its source text (Seneca, Lao Tzu, Emerson, Shakespeare, Proverbs and others). Returns up to 5 lines with author, book and source. Use plain words: "patience", "grief", "starting over", or an author’s name.

tools.name: get_verse
tools.description: Looks up a verse by reference ("John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "Quran 2:255", "Tao Te Ching 8") or finds one on a topic ("forgiveness", "fear"). Public-domain English translations only, and every result names its translation and licence. The Bible, Tanakh and Quran use standard verse numbers; the Gita, Dha

tools.name: one_action
tools.description: For when someone is stuck in a loop (scrolling, texting an ex, procrastinating, spiralling, craving). Returns Six Eight’s method as short guidance for you to follow in conversation, one relevant verified quote, and a matching practice from the 6:8 app when one fits. Nothing they write is stored. If

tools.name: take_compass
tools.description: Describes the 6:8 Alignment Compass, a free reflective quiz, and returns the link to take it. The quiz runs on sixeightapp.com, not in chat.
